_about: The Physical Mapping Register (Core Part 0.0.5 Rule 37; Companion Part 226): for each application of Omega42 to a physical system, B = (P, M, Phi, I, R, E): the system, its established model, the Omega42 representation, what the map preserves and leaves aside, the results with their classes, and the evidence. Checked by tools/physics_map.py.

entries.system: electrons in a one-dimensional Fibonacci quasicrystal (on-site potential)
entries.model: the Fibonacci Hamiltonian (H psi)_n = -psi_(n+1) - psi_(n-1) + v_n psi_n, v_n = V on a, 0 on b
entries.representation: the law as the substitution matrix; the transfer matrices as the law of the words in SL2; the gaps labeled in Z + Z phi
entries.preserves: the word, the trace map, the Fricke-Vogt invariant V^2/4, the integrated density of states in each gap
entries.leaves_aside: electron-electron interaction, disorder, the lattice in three dimensions
entries.map: domain: the Fibonacci Hamiltonian (H psi)_n = -psi_(n+1) - psi_(n-1) + v_n psi_n, v_n = V on a, 0 on b; codomain: the law as the substitution matrix; the transfer matrices as the law of the words in SL2; the gaps labeled in Z + Z phi

entries.system: light in a Fibonacci dielectric multilayer
entries.model: thin-film transfer matrices [[cos d, (i/n) sin d], [i n sin d, cos d]], transmittance 4/|m11 + m12 + m21 + m22|^2
entries.representation: the same word and trace map; the six-cycle at the quarter wave
entries.preserves: the transmittance of every generation, the optical Fricke-Vogt invariant
entries.map: domain: thin-film transfer matrices [[cos d, (i/n) sin d], [i n sin d, cos d]], transmittance 4/|m11 + m12 + m21 + m22|^2; codomain: the same word and trace map; the six-cycle at the quarter wave

entries.system: sound in a Fibonacci layered medium
entries.model: acoustic transfer matrices [[cos, i Z sin], [i sin/Z, cos]]
entries.representation: the optical engine with the index n for the impedance Z, by M(1/n) = J M(n) J
entries.map: domain: acoustic transfer matrices [[cos, i Z sin], [i sin/Z, cos]]; codomain: the optical engine with the index n for the impedance Z, by M(1/n) = J M(n) J

entries.system: quantized transport in a Fibonacci chain pumped by its phason
entries.model: the Kraus family of smooth potentials tending to the Fibonacci potential; the Chern number of a pump
entries.representation: the gap label n in Z + Z phi as the pumped charge
entries.leaves_aside: the rate of the pump, non-adiabatic effects

evidence.measurements: Core Appendix S.26; Core Appendix S.27

entries.map: domain: the Kraus family of smooth potentials tending to the Fibonacci potential; the Chern number of a pump; codomain: the gap label n in Z + Z phi as the pumped charge

entries.model: special relativity: the mass shell t^2 - x^2 - y^2 = 1 and the Lorentz group SO+(2,1), SO+(3,1)
entries.representation: the law acting by congruence X -> A X A^T; A^2 the golden boost; Q its axis
entries.preserves: the mass shell, the direction of time, the composition of collinear boosts
entries.map: domain: special relativity: the mass shell t^2 - x^2 - y^2 = 1 and the Lorentz group SO+(2,1), SO+(3,1); codomain: the law acting by congruence X -> A X A^T; A^2 the golden boost; Q its axis

entries.system: electrons in a square Fibonacci quasicrystal
entries.model: the separable Hamiltonian H_x + H_y on the product of two Fibonacci chains
entries.representation: the sum set of the chain's spectrum with itself
entries.leaves_aside: non-separable couplings, the Fibonacci grid with diagonal hopping
entries.map: domain: the separable Hamiltonian H_x + H_y on the product of two Fibonacci chains; codomain: the sum set of the chain's spectrum with itself

entries.model: the vertex model, hopping along the edges of the rhombus tiling
entries.representation: the pentagrid of the golden ring; the zero-energy density 81 - 50 phi in Z[phi]
entries.preserves: the five-fold local order, the ratio of thick to thin tiles
entries.map: domain: the vertex model, hopping along the edges of the rhombus tiling; codomain: the pentagrid of the golden ring; the zero-energy density 81 - 50 phi in Z[phi]

entries.system: the quasi-one-dimensional magnet CoNb2O6 near its quantum critical point
entries.model: the Ising chain in a transverse field and its E8 spectrum
entries.representation: the E8 masses and their golden ratio (MF-90)
entries.map: domain: the Ising chain in a transverse field and its E8 spectrum; codomain: the E8 masses and their golden ratio (MF-90)

entries.system: X-ray, electron or optical diffraction from a Fibonacci quasicrystal
entries.model: the Fourier transform of the Fibonacci letter sequence; nearly free electrons at weak coupling
entries.representation: Bragg peaks at frac(n F_(k-1)/F_k) with amplitude |sin(pi n/phi)|/(pi |n|), the labels of the gaps
entries.map: domain: the letter sequence of length F_k; codomain: the Fourier amplitudes, labeled by n in Z
entries.preserves: the label n of each peak and of the gap it opens; at weak coupling the gap width 2V times the amplitude
entries.leaves_aside: the atomic form factors, the Debye-Waller factor, two- and three-dimensional samples

entries.system: Fibonacci anyons in a topological quantum medium
entries.model: the Fibonacci anyon model: fusion rules, F- and R-matrices, braid group representations
entries.representation: the law as the fusion matrix N_tau; phi as the quantum dimension; F_n as the dimension of n anyons
entries.map: domain: the fusion rules in the basis (1, tau); codomain: the matrix A
entries.preserves: the fusion counts, the quantum dimension, the braid relation
entries.leaves_aside: the microscopic medium, the energy gap that protects the anyons

entries.system: a nine-level quantum system (a qudit of dimension 9)
entries.model: the Weyl-Heisenberg group, the Clifford group and the discrete Wigner function of odd dimension
entries.representation: the 81 states as the discrete phase space; A^2 as a Clifford unitary; A as an antiunitary
entries.map: domain: the 81 states (a, b); codomain: the Weyl operators D(a, b) and phase-point operators on C^9
entries.preserves: the Weyl relations, the Wigner function under the law, the complementarity of bases
entries.leaves_aside: a physical carrier of the nine levels, noise, measurement

entries.system: a quantum walker on a line whose coin follows the Fibonacci word in time
entries.model: the discrete-time quantum walk, U = S (C x I), with two reflecting coins in Fibonacci order
entries.representation: the law's word as the sequence of coins; the trace map of the walk (Romanelli)
entries.map: domain: the Fibonacci word; codomain: the sequence of unitary steps of the walk
